purpose: Teach: 素晴らしく/長々/目の当たり/ひいては/がらみ/つれづれ/なにせ/もろもろ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの絵は素晴らしくお上手ね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's drawing is really wonderful.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Soft smile in the voice. A beat of real noticing — not automatic, but truly seeing his work. Unhurried and sincere.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが長々とお話されたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad talked for a really long time.
lines.style: Quiet observation with a thread of dry humor underneath. Not complaining — just noticing. Small, genuine laugh barely audible. A child's perceptiveness masked as innocence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお元気な姿を目の当たりにできたわね
lines.en: Sho, we got to see Grandpa looking so well today, didn't we.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tenderness. Speaking more to herself than to him, but including him. A quiet gratitude that lands gently. No rush — space between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ひいては家族のために頑張るよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to work hard for you and the family.
lines.style: Earnest, steady, almost solemn. A child's vow spoken with real seriousness. No performance — he means this. Clear eyes. Slight formality in the cadence, like he's thought about the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは仕事がらみのお話が多いわね
lines.en: Sho, Dad did talk a lot about work, didn't he.
lines.style: Quiet, half-amused observation. A gentle, tired knowing in the voice — she's noticing something about her husband. Affectionate but rueful. Not critical, just... seeing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、つれづれにお絵描きしてたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was just drawing quietly.
lines.style: Small, unbothered voice. Not defensive — just answering simply. A six-year-old's contentment in his own world. Soft and present without trying to be.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、なにせ初めての発表会だから緊張するわね
lines.en: Sho, this is his first recital, so he must be nervous.
lines.style: Tender concern wrapped in practical acceptance. Speaking to herself as much as to him. A mother's quiet awareness of something that matters. Slight warmth in addressing the worry without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、もろもろの準備をお手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to help you get everything ready.
lines.style: Eager and earnest, close to her. A small volunteer's enthusiasm — genuine desire to help, not performing helpfulness. Bright but not loud. The eagerness of a child who wants to be useful to someone he loves.
